text:
The Witcher 4 Will Have a Physical Edition (Even if PlayStation Kills Discs) - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
CD Projekt RED has confirmed that, regardless of what happens with physical media on consoles, The Witcher 4 will have some kind of physical release. Sony has already announced plans to stop physical media production on first-party titles in 2028, leading many to speculate that the PS6 will be completely digital, a move that will effectively kill physical media for games. Even if The Witcher 4, which is due out sometime in 2028, won't have a disc, CD Projekt RED would still want collectors to have something physical. In related news, Sony is doubling down on their all-digital future, arguing in court that gamers do not have any reasonable expectation of owning their digital purchases from the PlayStation Network. And finally, Sony is airing another State of Play showcase tomorrow at 6am Pacific.

The Blood of Dawnwalker Gameplay: The First 19 Minutes
See how your adventure as a vampire begins in the opening minutes of The Blood of Dawnwalker. Set in the mid 1300s, The Blood of Dawnwalker sees you take the role of Coen, a village dweller whose life revolved around the family and community. The quiet, country side life quickly takes a turn for the worse and sets you out on an adventure over 30 days to save your family before they're sacrificed in a vampiric ritual.

The Uprising - Official Gameplay Trailer (Created in Fortnite)
Watch the Gameplay Trailer for The Uprising, an interactive experience created within Fortnite and developed by Sawhorse Productions and published by Genesis Studios in partnership with Focus Features. Players will fight in large-scale multiplayer battles inspired by the events and visual landscape of The Uprising. Wield era-inspired melee weapons and bows, earn in-match currency, and strategically upgrade their health, speed, and damage throughout the fight. The Uprising experience is available now in Fortnite.

The Uprising film is in theaters on September 10.

Fool Night - Official Teaser Trailer 2 (2026)
Check out the latest trailer for the upcoming anime, Fool Night! All episodes start streaming on Thursday, November 26, 2026, only on Netflix. In their first collaboration, Sunrise and Shaft present “Fool Night," a highly anticipated anime adaptation of the globally acclaimed manga.
Transfloration — a technology that implants seeds into the bodies of those near death, transforming them into plants. It is the desperate measure humanity has chosen to ensure its survival.
In a distant future where thick clouds cover the sky, trapping Earth in constant winter and night, most of the planet’s vegetation has withered away. Facing a serious oxygen shortage, humanity has built a society that relies on the meager amount of oxygen provided by Transfloration.
A young man, Toshiro Kamiya, lives in poverty and works hard to pay taxes, cover living expenses, and afford medication for his mentally ill mother. However, the cruel reality around him gradually eats away at his hope.
